name: Apparatus Scroll Text Reveal
pitch: Kinetic per-character scroll reveal text section transitioning smoothly from muted depth to high clarity.

lifecycle.idle: Initial section loaded with headline and scroll indicator.
lifecycle.discovery: First scroll down enters section 2 reveal region.
lifecycle.buildUp: Text characters illuminate and lift gradually as scroll progresses.
lifecycle.peak: Paragraph is fully crisp, unmasked, and aligned at maximum readability.
lifecycle.recovery: Scrolling up gently recedes text depth back to initial state.
